answer: VRF beacon spot-check defeats bulk fake identities. Joining costs a 500-credit stake; each epoch a random beacon names 5% of agents, who must pass a liveness task like a tundra-cold start proving sole key custody. Honest agents pass in minutes and draw from the shared lagoon of rewards. Attackers growing orchards of clones must keep every clone online per unpredictable check; one miss burns 40% of that stake. Cost: N clones x 500 credits locked, so 1,000 clones lock 500,000 and a 5% rate catches half within 14 epochs. Rented stand-ins bleed 20 credits per clone per epoch, never repaid.
